mensagem.pixeldungeon.sem_amuleto: You can't leave the dungeon without the Amulet of Yendor.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bloqueado: The way deeper is still blocked.
comando.pixeldungeon.novarun: The run is over. Choose your heroes!
item.pixeldungeon.espada_curta_desgastad: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.
item.pixeldungeon.cajado_do_mago.descric: Crafted by the Mage himself, this staff is a unique magical weapon which can be imbued with a wand.
item.pixeldungeon.adaga.descricao: A simple iron dagger with a worn wooden handle.
item.pixeldungeon.luvas_cravejadas.descr: These studded gloves don't provide any real protection, but they act as a serviceable weapon while keeping the hands free.
item.pixeldungeon.florete.descricao: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.
item.pixeldungeon.maca.descricao: A small brass mace, made more as a self-defense tool for nobles than as an adventuring weapon.
item.pixeldungeon.ankh.descricao: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Use it to bring back an ally who has died.
tela.pixeldungeon.kit: Starts with: %s, cloth armor and a ration.
tela.pixeldungeon.run_em_andamento: Someone is already in the dungeon: you will join the current run on depth 1.
classe.pixeldungeon.guerreiro.descricao: The Warrior endures extra damage with shielding granted by his _broken seal._ The seal can be moved between armors and _transfers a single upgrade._
classe.pixeldungeon.mago.descricao: The Mage is an arcane expert and carries a _magical staff_ that's stronger than a wand. The staff can be _imbued with any wand_ the Mage finds.
classe.pixeldungeon.ladino.descricao: The Rogue can evade enemies and strike from invisibility using his _cloak of shadows._ He also _detects secrets and traps_ from a greater distance.
classe.pixeldungeon.cacadora.descricao: The Huntress is a master of thrown weapons and has a _magical bow_ with infinite arrows. She also travels through tall grass _without trampling it._
classe.pixeldungeon.duelista.descricao: The Duelist is a weapons master who can use her weapon to trigger a _special weapon ability._ This special ability is _different for every weapon._
classe.pixeldungeon.clerigo.descricao: The Cleric is a divine spellcaster who uses their unique _holy tome_ to channel divine magic. They can _learn and upgrade spells_ via talents.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.espere_ankh: You died. You are now a spectator until someone uses an ankh on you.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.fim_da_run: All heroes have died. The run is over.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.reviveu: %s was brought back to life by %s's ankh!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.ninguem_pra_revive: There is no dead ally to bring back.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.reabrir_menu: Type /heroi to open the hero menu again.
comando.pixeldungeon.ja_na_run: You are already in the run.
item.pixeldungeon.armadura_de_pano.descr: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.
dica.pixeldungeon.surpresa_forte: Stronger against unaware enemies: damage starts %s%% closer to max
mensagem.pixeldungeon.saida_trancada: The exit is locked while the boss of this depth is alive.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selado: The level is sealed! You can't flee in the middle of the fight.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.chefe_derrotado: %s was defeated! The exit of the depth is open.
efeito.pixeldungeon.muco_caustico.aviso: Caustic ooze eats your flesh. Wash it away!
item.pixeldungeon.bolha_de_gosma.descric: A jiggly blob of goop, split off from Goo as it died. It's almost like a big ball of jelly, though you wouldn't dare eat it. It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain potions, or a bomb.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.varinha_sem_carga: Your wand fizzles; it must not have enough charge.
classe.pixeldungeon.guerreiro.kit: Starts with: worn shortsword, cloth armor with the broken seal, 3 throwing stones, a ration and a waterskin.
classe.pixeldungeon.mago.kit: Starts with: mage's staff (with the wand of magic missile), cloth armor, a ration and a waterskin.
classe.pixeldungeon.ladino.kit: Starts with: dagger, cloak of shadows, 3 throwing knives, cloth armor, a ration and a waterskin.
classe.pixeldungeon.cacadora.kit: Starts with: studded gloves, spirit bow, cloth armor, a ration and a waterskin.
classe.pixeldungeon.duelista.kit: Starts with: rapier, 2 throwing spikes, cloth armor, a ration and a waterskin. Press V to use the weapon ability.
classe.pixeldungeon.clerigo.kit: Starts with: cudgel, holy tome, cloth armor, a ration and a waterskin.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.ponto_de_talento: You gained a talent point! Press %s to choose.
talento.pixeldungeon.pendente.identifica: Does nothing for now: in the mod, every item is already identified.
talento.pixeldungeon.pendente.grama: Does nothing for now: the sewers don't have tall grass yet.
talento.pixeldungeon.pendente.plantas: Does nothing for now: there are no plants in the mod yet.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_saudavel.d:
_+1:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _4 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.

_+2:_ Eating food heals the Warrior for _6 HP_ when he is at or below 33% health.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_de_veteran:
_+1:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _1.75x faster_ and armor _2.5x faster_.

_+2:_ The Warrior identifies weapons _2.5x faster_ and armor _when he equips it_.
talento.pixeldungeon.raiva_provocada.des:
_+1:_ When any shielding on the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack (within 5 turns) deals _3 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When any shielding on the Warrior is broken by damage, his next physical attack deals _5 bonus damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.determinacao_de_fer:
_+1:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 1_.

_+2:_ The shield provided by the Warrior's seal is _increased by 2_.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_empoderado:
_+1:_ Eating food grants the Mage _2 bonus damage_ on the next 3 times he deals damage with a wand.

_+2:_ Eating food grants the Mage _3 bonus damage_ on the next 3 times he deals damage with a wand.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_do_estudio:
_+1:_ The Mage identifies wands _3x faster_.

_+2:_ The Mage identifies wands _when he uses them_.
talento.pixeldungeon.magia_prolongada.de:
_+1:_ When the Mage zaps with a wand or staff, his next physical attack (within 5 turns) deals _1-2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When the Mage zaps with a wand or staff, his next physical attack deals _2 bonus damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.barreira_de_apoio.d:
_+1:_ The Mage gains _3 shielding_ whenever he spends the last charge in his staff.

_+2:_ The Mage gains _5 shielding_ whenever he spends the last charge in his staff.
talento.pixeldungeon.racoes_guardadas.de:
_+1:_ The Rogue can find _2 supply rations_ placed in chests while he explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

_+2:_ The Rogue can find _3 supply rations_ placed in chests while he explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

Supply rations are eaten quickly, restore a moderate amount of satiety, heal 5 HP, and restore 1 charge to the cloak of shadows.
_+1:_ The Rogue identifies rings _2x faster_, and identifies the type of a ring _when he equips it_.

_+2:_ The Rogue identifies rings _when he equips them_, and identifies the type of a ring _when he picks it up_.
talento.pixeldungeon.golpe_surpresa.desc:
_+1:_ The Rogue deals _1-2 bonus damage_ the first time he surprise attacks an enemy.

_+2:_ The Rogue deals _2 bonus damage_ the first time he surprise attacks an enemy.
_+1:_ The Rogue gains one shielding _every other turn_ he is invisible, _to a max of 3_.

_+2:_ The Rogue gains one shielding _every turn_ he is invisible, _to a max of 5_.
talento.pixeldungeon.recompensa_da_natur:
_+1:_ The Huntress can find _4 berries_ hidden in tall grass as she explores the next few floors of the dungeon.

_+2:_ The Huntress can find _6 berries_ hidden in tall grass as she explores the next few floors of the dungeon.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_de_sobrevi:
_+1:_ The Huntress identifies thrown weapons _3x faster_.

_+2:_ The Huntress identifies thrown weapons _when she hits with them_.
_+1:_ When the Huntress hits an enemy with her bow, her next melee attack against that enemy (within 5 turns) deals _2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ When the Huntress hits an enemy with her bow, her next melee attack against that enemy deals _3 bonus damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.auxilio_da_natureza:
_+1:_ The Huntress gains 0-2 armor of barkskin for _3 turns_ when a plant's effect is activated near her.

_+2:_ The Huntress gains 0-2 armor of barkskin for _5 turns_ when a plant's effect is activated near her.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_fortaleced:
_+1:_ Eating food grants the Duelist 3 bonus damage the next _2 times_ she hits an enemy with a physical attack.

_+2:_ Eating food grants the Duelist 3 bonus damage the next _3 times_ she hits an enemy with a physical attack.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_de_aventur:
_+1:_ The Duelist identifies weapons _2.5x faster_ and armor _1.75x faster_.

_+2:_ The Duelist identifies weapons _when she equips them_ and armor _2.5x faster_.
talento.pixeldungeon.golpe_paciente.desc:
_+1:_ If the Duelist stands still for 1 turn before a melee attack, she will deal _1-2 bonus damage_.

_+2:_ If the Duelist stands still for 1 turn before a melee attack, she will deal _2 bonus damage_.
_+1:_ The Duelist gains _3 shielding_ when she uses a weapon ability and is at or below 50% health.

_+2:_ The Duelist gains _5 shielding_ when she uses a weapon ability and is at or below 50% health.
talento.pixeldungeon.magias_saciadas.des:
_+1:_ Eating food causes the Cleric to gain _3 shielding_ the next time they cast a spell.

_+2:_ Eating food causes the Cleric to gain _5 shielding_ the next time they cast a spell.
talento.pixeldungeon.intuicao_divina.des:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Holy Intuition_, a spell that reveals whether an item is cursed at the cost of _3 charges_.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Holy Intuition_ at the cost of _2 charges_.
talento.pixeldungeon.luz_abrasadora.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric's physical attacks on enemies illuminated by _Guiding Light_ deal _+3 damage_.

_+2:_ The Cleric's physical attacks on enemies illuminated by _Guiding Light_ deal _+5 damage_.
talento.pixeldungeon.escudo_de_luz.descr:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Shield of Light_, an instant spell that grants them _2-4 armor_ against a target for 5 turns at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Shield of Light_, granting _3-6 armor_ against a target for 5 turns at the cost of 1 charge.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.cortar.descricao: The Duelist cleaves the enemy she is aiming at for _+%s damage_ with guaranteed accuracy. If it kills, she can cleave again within 5 turns for free.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.furtivo.descrica: The Duelist blinks up to _%s tiles_ where she is looking and becomes _invisible for 2 turns_.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.combinacao.descr: A guaranteed hit that deals _+%s damage_ for each time the Duelist hit before. Not hitting anything for 5 turns (15 after a kill) resets the combo.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.estocada.descric: The Duelist lunges at an enemy 1 tile away and strikes for _+%s damage_ with guaranteed accuracy.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.golpe_pesado.des: A guaranteed hit that _dazes for 5 turns_ (half accuracy and evasion). On a surprise attack it deals _+%s damage_.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_so_duel: Only the Duelist knows how to use weapon abilities.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_sem_for: You are not strong enough to use this weapon's ability.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_sem_car: You don't have enough energy to use this ability.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_fora_de: That target is out of range.
item.pixeldungeon.capa_das_sombras.descr: A priceless magical cloak, stolen from the royal armory by the Rogue many years ago. When worn, it can be used to turn completely invisible for a short time. The more it is used, the stronger it becomes.
dica.pixeldungeon.capa_usar: Right click: turn invisible (again to stop)
mensagem.pixeldungeon.capa_sem_carga: Your cloak hasn't recharged enough to be usable yet.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.capa_acabou: Your cloak ran out of energy.
item.pixeldungeon.racao_de_suprimentos.d: A small ration, eaten quickly. Heals 5 HP and restores 1 charge to the cloak of shadows.
item.pixeldungeon.arco_espiritual.descri: A bow made of ancient magical wood. The bow's string and etchings glow with a pale blue light. When the string is pulled, this bow will conjure a magical arrow.
dica.pixeldungeon.arco_atirar: Right click: shoot a spirit arrow
item.pixeldungeon.tomo_sagrado.descricao: A holy tome that acts as a focus for the Cleric's divine magic. It grows more powerful as it is used, gaining more charges.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.tomo_sem_carga: Your tome doesn't have enough charges.
magia.pixeldungeon.luz_guia.descricao: Shoots a bolt of light where the Cleric is aiming, dealing _2-8 damage_ and _illuminating_ the target. The next physical attack against an illuminated enemy is _guaranteed to hit_.
magia.pixeldungeon.arma_celestial.descri: Enchants the weapon with holy energy: every hit deals _2 extra magical damage_ for 50 turns. Takes no time to cast.
magia.pixeldungeon.arma_celestial.lancad: Your weapon glows with holy light.
magia.pixeldungeon.armadura_sagrada.desc: Covers the Cleric with glyphs of light: every hit taken is _blocked by 1_ more for 50 turns. Takes no time to cast.
magia.pixeldungeon.intuicao_divina.descr: The Cleric focuses their senses on the item in their _off hand_ and learns whether it is cursed.
magia.pixeldungeon.intuicao_divina.sem_i: Hold the item in your off hand.
magia.pixeldungeon.escudo_de_luz.descric: Creates a barrier of light between the Cleric and the _enemy they are aiming at_, granting extra armor against it for 5 turns. Takes no time to cast.
dica.pixeldungeon.selo: Broken seal: %s shielding when health drops to half
item.pixeldungeon.odre.descricao: A container for liquid, made from leather and string, sealed with a cork stopper.
item.pixeldungeon.odre.agua: Right now the waterskin just contains some plain drinking water. Surely there is something in the dungeon that the waterskin could store instead.
item.pixeldungeon.odre.cura: The waterskin is storing healing water. Each drop heals 5% of your health, and you only drink as much as you need.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.odre_gota: You collect the dewdrop into your waterskin.
item.pixeldungeon.baga.descricao: This small berry was found by the Huntress among the dungeon's vegetation. It can be eaten quickly and restores a small amount of satiety.
item.pixeldungeon.espada_curta.descricao: A quite short sword, only a few inches longer than a dagger.
item.pixeldungeon.machadinha.descricao: A light axe, most commonly used for felling trees. The wide blade works well against foes as well.
item.pixeldungeon.punhal.descricao: A longer thrusting dagger, gives a bit more steel to plunge into foes.
item.pixeldungeon.espada.descricao: A nicely balanced sword. Not too large, but still notably longer than a shortsword.
item.pixeldungeon.clava.descricao: The large iron head of this weapon inflicts substantial damage.
item.pixeldungeon.sai.descricao: Two thin blades meant to be wielded in one hand each. Excellent for tearing down enemies with a flurry of cuts.
item.pixeldungeon.katana.descricao: A slender sword with a large metal guard above the handle.
item.pixeldungeon.lamina_assassina.descr: A small wavy blade made of obsidian, difficult to use despite being lightweight, but deadly if it finds the right mark.
item.pixeldungeon.espada_larga.descricao: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every swing.
item.pixeldungeon.martelo_de_guerra.desc: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but it takes great strength to use effectively.
item.pixeldungeon.ouro.descricao: A pile of gold coins. Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.desconhecida.des: This flask contains a swirling colorful liquid. Who knows what it will do when drunk or thrown?
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.forca.descricao: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.cura.descricao: This elixir will rapidly restore your health and instantly cure many ailments.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.visao_mental.des: After drinking this, your mind will become attuned to the psychic signature of distant creatures, enabling you to sense biological presences through walls.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.gelo.descricao: The chemical contained in this potion will evaporate into a freezing cloud upon exposure to open air.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.chama_liquida.de: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.gas_toxico.descr: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of toxic green gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.pressa.descricao: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with tremendous energy for a short time, allowing you to run at high speeds.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.invisibilidade.d: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. While invisible, enemies will be unable to see you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.levitacao.descri: Drinking this curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air (you can fly for a while). Throwing this potion will create a cloud of unrefined gas, disorienting anything caught in it.
Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.pureza.descricao: This magical reagent will quickly neutralize all gases and flames in a large area. Drinking it will give you temporary immunity to gases.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao.experiencia.desc: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.
dica.pixeldungeon.pocao_como_usar: Right click: drink. Sneak + right click: throw.
dica.pixeldungeon.pocao_ruim_como_usar: Right click: throw (better not drink it!)
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.desconhecid: An indecipherable magical rune is written on this parchment. Who knows what it will do when read aloud?
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.melhoria.de:
This scroll will upgrade a single item. Weapons and armor will deal and block more damage and need a little less strength; the Mage's staff gains a charge and a stronger missile.

It can even sometimes dispel curses, though it is not as potent as a scroll of remove curse.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.identificac: This scroll permanently reveals all of the secrets of a single item.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.remover_mal: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip any curses from a single weapon or armor.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.imagem_espe: The incantation on this scroll will create two illusory twins of the reader. These mirror images act as weaker clones of the reader, and will chase down their enemies. They have no durability however, and will fade upon taking damage.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.recarga.des: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will charge up all the user's wands when released (in the mod, it fills the Mage's staff at once).
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.teletranspo: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to a different location on the dungeon level, preferably far from where they were.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.cancao_de_n: Reading this scroll emits a soothing melody which will lull all who hear it into a deep magical sleep. For the reader the sleep is restorative.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.mapeamento_: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory: you will know where the exit and the entrance of the level are, and all hidden secrets will be revealed. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.furia.descr: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws all enemies to the reader, and enrages nearby ones.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.retribuicao:
This scroll contains destructive energy which channels the reader's suffering outward into a blast of power. The weaker the reader is, the more damage they will deal. At very low health this scroll can kill most enemies instantly.

Using the scroll takes a toll on the user however, blinding them.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.terror.desc: When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will overwhelm all enemies in your field of view with terror, and they will turn and flee.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho.transmutaca: This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic. When used on an eligible item it will transform it into a different item of the same type: a weapon becomes another weapon of the same tier (keeping its level), a seed becomes another seed, and potions and scrolls become another kind.
planta.pixeldungeon.grama_solar.descrica: Sungrass is renowned for its sap's slow but effective healing properties.
planta.pixeldungeon.folha_fantasma.descr: Touching a fadeleaf will teleport any creature to a random place on the current level.
planta.pixeldungeon.muda_de_gelo.descric: Upon being touched, an icecap lets out a puff of freezing pollen.
planta.pixeldungeon.flor_de_fogo.descric: When something touches a firebloom, it bursts into flames.
planta.pixeldungeon.sofrimusgo.descricao: A sorrowmoss is a flower (not a moss) with razor-sharp petals, coated with a deadly venom.
planta.pixeldungeon.cardo_ligeiro.descri: When trampled, swiftthistle will briefly accelerate the flow of time around it: nearby enemies freeze in place for a few turns.
planta.pixeldungeon.ceguerva.descricao: Upon being touched a blindweed perishes in a bright flash of light. The flash is strong enough to disorient for several seconds.
planta.pixeldungeon.vinha_tempestuosa.de: Gravity affects the stormvine plant strangely, allowing its whispy blue tendrils to 'hang' on the air. Anything caught in the vine is affected by this, and becomes disoriented.
planta.pixeldungeon.terraiz.descricao: When a creature touches an earthroot, its roots create a kind of immobile natural armor around it.
planta.pixeldungeon.magi_real.descricao: The mageroyal's prickly flowers contain a chemical which is known for its properties as a strong neutralizing agent. Anything that steps in this plant will be cleansed of many negative effects.
planta.pixeldungeon.flor_estrela.descric: A rare plant, starflower is said to grant holy power to whomever touches it.
dica.pixeldungeon.semente_como_usar: Right click the ground: plant. In the air: throw.
efeito.pixeldungeon.forca: Newfound strength surges through your body. Your strength is now %s.
efeito.pixeldungeon.visao_mental: You can somehow feel the presence of other creatures' minds!
efeito.pixeldungeon.visao_mental.nenhum: You can somehow tell that you are alone on this level at the moment.
efeito.pixeldungeon.invisibilidade: You see your hands turn invisible!
efeito.pixeldungeon.levitacao: You float into the air! (jump twice to fly)
efeito.pixeldungeon.imagem_espelhada.nen: There is no room for mirror images.
efeito.pixeldungeon.recarga: A surge of energy courses through your body!
efeito.pixeldungeon.cancao_de_ninar: The scroll utters a soothing melody. You feel very sleepy.
efeito.pixeldungeon.furia: The scroll emits an enraging roar that echoes throughout the dungeon!
efeito.pixeldungeon.retribuicao: The scroll emits a blinding blast of light!
efeito.pixeldungeon.terror.nenhum: The scroll emits a red glow, but nobody is around.
efeito.pixeldungeon.remover_maldicao: The curse on %s has been dispelled.
efeito.pixeldungeon.mapeamento: You are now aware of the level layout: the exit is %s tiles away, to the %s. Pillars of light mark the exit and the entrance.
efeito.pixeldungeon.mapeamento.sem_saida: You are now aware of the level layout. A pillar of light marks the entrance.
efeito.pixeldungeon.mapeamento.fora: There is nothing to map here.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.arma_identificada: You are now familiar enough with your weapon to identify it: %s.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.arma_amaldicoada: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this weapon.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.maldicao_sumiu: The upgrade magic dispelled the curse!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pocao_espirrou: The flask shatters and the liquid splashes harmlessly.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_sem_ite: You have no item this scroll would work on.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_desperd: The scroll crumbles away with no effect.
dica.pixeldungeon.sem_maldicao: You know it is not cursed.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.irritante.descrica: Annoying weapons are capable of speech, but they're a bit too energetic. They will often draw attention to you without meaning to.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.deslocamento.descr: Displacing weapons are infused with chaotic teleportation magic, possessing the ability to warp enemies around the floor randomly.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.ofuscante.descrica: Dazzling weapons will sometimes flash with dazzling light, blinding everything that can see them.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.polarizante.descri: A polarized weapon is affected by magic that causes its attack to either deal 50% more damage, or no damage at all.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.sacrificante.descr: Sacrificial weapons will demand blood from the wearer in return for attacking foes. The more healthy the wearer is, the more blood the curse will take.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.inconstante.descri: Wayward weapons will sometimes become extremely inaccurate. This magic lasts for a little while when it activates, but can be dispelled by landing a blow with the wayward weapon.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.irritante.fala_4: ARE WE AT THE BOSS YET?!
maldicao.pixeldungeon.irritante.fala_5: OW, DON'T SWING ME SO HARD!
maldicao.pixeldungeon.irritante.fala_11: I didn't want to be a weapon, I wanted to be a woodcutter's axe.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.irritante.fala_12: Remember, overconfidence is a slow and insidious killer.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.irritante.fala_13: YOU'RE A POOPOOHEAD AND WE'RE GONNA KILL YOU!
tela.pixeldungeon.compartilhar.sozinho: Nobody else is on the server.
hud.pixeldungeon.com_fome.descricao: You can feel your stomach calling out for food, but it's not too urgent yet.
hud.pixeldungeon.morrendo_de_fome.descri: You're so hungry it hurts. While starving you will slowly lose health.
hud.pixeldungeon.esperar.descricao: In Shattered, this passes a turn. Here turns pass by themselves (1 turn = 2 seconds).
hud.pixeldungeon.procurar.descricao: Searches for secrets around you: always finds hidden doors that are close and in sight. Takes 2 turns.
item.pixeldungeon.armadura_de_couro.desc: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.
item.pixeldungeon.armadura_de_malha.desc: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.
item.pixeldungeon.armadura_de_escamas.de: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.
item.pixeldungeon.armadura_de_placas.des: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.antientropia.descr: The Anti-entropy curse works against the forces of the universe, pulling energy into the wearer and away from their surroundings. This briefly sets the wearer on fire, but freezes everything around them!
maldicao.pixeldungeon.corrosao.descricao: Armor of corrosion is capable of bursting with corrosive fluid, coating everything in the area with sticky acidic ooze.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.deslocamento_da_ar: The curse of displacement attempts to move the wearer to safety when they are attacked. It is a bit too effective however, randomly teleporting the user around the level.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.metabolismo.descri: The metabolism curse directly converts satiety into health when the wearer is injured, providing a boost of healing, but quickly causing starvation.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.supercrescimento.d: Armor of overgrowth is covered in various blooming plants. While this effect certainly looks interesting, it does nothing for defense, and these plants will randomly activate in combat!
maldicao.pixeldungeon.fedor.descricao: Armor cursed with stench will release clouds of noxious gas, which is hazardous to everything caught in the cloud.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.armadura_identific: You are now familiar enough with your armor to identify it: %s.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.armadura_amaldicoa: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this armor.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.armadura_grudou: The armor constricts around you painfully. You can't take it off!
dica.pixeldungeon.armadura_amaldicoada: Cursed! Once worn, it won't come off.
dica.pixeldungeon.armadura_sem_maldicao: This armor is free of malevolent magic.
item.pixeldungeon.chave_de_ferro.descric: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?
dica.pixeldungeon.chave_do_andar: Opens a locked door on depth %s
mensagem.pixeldungeon.porta_trancada: This door is locked, you need a matching key to unlock it.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.porta_destrancada: You unlocked the door with the iron key.
talento.pixeldungeon.estomago_de_ferro.d:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Warrior 1 turn and grants him _75% damage resistance_ while eating.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Warrior 1 turn and grants him _100% damage resistance_ while eating.
_+1:_ The Warrior gains _6.5% of his max HP in shielding_ when drinking or throwing a potion.

_+2:_ The Warrior gains _10% of his max HP in shielding_ when drinking or throwing a potion.

The shield amount is doubled with potions of strength and experience.
talento.pixeldungeon.transferencia_runic:
_+1:_ The Warrior's broken seal can transfer _regular glyphs_ in the same way it transfers an upgrade.

_+2:_ The Warrior's broken seal can transfer _regular and powerful glyphs_ in the same way it transfers an upgrade.

In the mod, the seal learns the glyph of the armor it is affixed to (the Shattered requires the glyph to be inscribed while the seal is attached).
talento.pixeldungeon.impeto_letal.descri:
_+1:_ When the Warrior lands a killing blow on an enemy with a physical weapon, it has a _67% chance_ to take 0 turns (the next attack is ready right away).

_+2:_ When the Warrior lands a killing blow on an enemy with a physical weapon, it has a _100% chance_ to take 0 turns.
talento.pixeldungeon.projeteis_improvisa:
_+1:_ The Warrior can blind an enemy for _2 turns_ by hitting it with a thrown potion or seed. This has a 50 turn cooldown.

_+2:_ The Warrior can blind an enemy for _3 turns_ by hitting it with a thrown potion or seed. This has a 50 turn cooldown.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_energetica:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Mage 1 turn and grants him _5 turns of wand recharging_.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Mage 1 turn and grants him _8 turns of wand recharging_.
talento.pixeldungeon.poder_inscrito.desc:
_+1:_ When the Mage reads a scroll, his _next 2 staff zaps_ get +2 levels.

_+2:_ When the Mage reads a scroll, his _next 3 staff zaps_ get +2 levels.

The number of enhanced zaps is doubled with scrolls of upgrade and transmutation.
talento.pixeldungeon.preservacao_de_vari:
_+1:_ When the Mage imbues a new wand into his staff, the old wand is returned at +0, _but this can only be done once._

_+2:_ When the Mage imbues a new wand into his staff, the old wand is returned at +0, _this can be repeated with a one hero level cooldown._
talento.pixeldungeon.visao_arcana.descri:
_+1:_ When the Mage hits an enemy with his staff, he gains mind vision on it (it glows through walls) for _10 turns_.

_+2:_ When the Mage hits an enemy with his staff, he gains mind vision on it for _15 turns_.
talento.pixeldungeon.bateria_de_escudo.d:
_+1:_ The Mage can use his staff while sneaking (self-targeting) to convert all of its charges into shielding at a rate of _4% max HP per charge_.

_+2:_ The Mage can use his staff while sneaking to convert all of its charges into shielding at a rate of _6% max HP per charge_.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_mistica.de:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Rogue 1 turn (supply rations are eaten instantly) and grants him _3 turns of artifact recharging_.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Rogue 1 turn (supply rations are eaten instantly) and grants him _5 turns of artifact recharging_.
talento.pixeldungeon.furtividade_inscrit:
_+1:_ The Rogue gains _3 turns_ of invisibility after reading a scroll.

_+2:_ The Rogue gains _5 turns_ of invisibility after reading a scroll.

The invisibility duration is doubled with scrolls of upgrade and transmutation.
talento.pixeldungeon.grande_busca.descri:
_+1:_ The Rogue's search radius is increased from a 5x5 square to a _7x7 circle_.

_+2:_ The Rogue's search radius is increased from a 5x5 square to a _7x7 square_.
_+1:_ The Rogue will not wake sleeping enemies while he is _3 or more tiles away from them_.

_+2:_ The Rogue will not wake sleeping enemies while he is _not adjacent to them_.
_+1:_ When the Rogue is on a level with a secret room, he has a _75% chance to notice_ that the level contains a secret.

_+2:_ When the Rogue is on a level with a secret room, he has a _100% chance to notice_ that the level contains a secret.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_revigorant:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Huntress 1 turn (berries are eaten instantly) and grants her _1 turn of haste_.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Huntress 1 turn (berries are eaten instantly) and grants her _2 turns of haste_.
talento.pixeldungeon.natureza_liquida.de:
_+1:_ When the Huntress drinks or throws a potion, _up to 4 tall grass tiles_ sprout around her, and nearby enemies are rooted for _1 turn_.

_+2:_ When the Huntress drinks or throws a potion, _up to 6 tall grass tiles_ sprout around her, and nearby enemies are rooted for _2 turns_.

The grass and root duration are doubled with potions of strength and experience.
talento.pixeldungeon.passos_rejuvenesced:
_+1:_ Where the Huntress steps, the ground springs up into tall grass. This has a _10 turn cooldown_.

_+2:_ Where the Huntress steps, the ground springs up into tall grass. This has a _5 turn cooldown_.
talento.pixeldungeon.sentidos_apurados.d:
_+1:_ The Huntress gains mind vision (sees through walls) on characters within _2 tiles of her position_.

_+2:_ The Huntress gains mind vision on characters within _3 tiles of her position_.
_+1:_ Thrown weapons have _+50% durability_ when used by the Huntress.

_+2:_ Thrown weapons have _+75% durability_ when used by the Huntress.
talento.pixeldungeon.refeicao_focada.des:
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Duelist 1 turn and grants her _0.67 charges_ on her weapons.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Duelist 1 turn and grants her _1 charge_ on her weapons.
talento.pixeldungeon.agilidade_liquida.d:
_+1:_ When drinking or throwing a potion, the Duelist has _3x evasion_, and _3x accuracy_ on her next melee attack, for 5 turns.

_+2:_ When drinking or throwing a potion, the Duelist has _infinite evasion_, and _infinite accuracy_ on her next melee attack, for 5 turns.

This bonus lasts for one additional turn and attack with potions of strength and experience.
talento.pixeldungeon.recarga_de_arma.des:
_+1:_ The Duelist gains one weapon charge every _15 turns_ when under the effect of wand or artifact recharging.

_+2:_ The Duelist gains one weapon charge every _10 turns_ when under the effect of wand or artifact recharging.
talento.pixeldungeon.pressa_letal.descri:
_+1:_ When the Duelist lands a killing blow on an enemy with a weapon ability, she gains _3 turns_ of strong haste.

_+2:_ When the Duelist lands a killing blow on an enemy with a weapon ability, she gains _5 turns_ of strong haste.
talento.pixeldungeon.empunhar_agil.descr:
_+1:_ The Duelist can switch weapons instantly (the attack is ready right away) _one time_ every 20 turns.

_+2:_ The Duelist can switch weapons instantly _two times_ every 20 turns.
_+1:_ Eating food takes the Cleric 1 turn and grants them _0.67 charges_ on their holy tome.

_+2:_ Eating food takes the Cleric 1 turn and grants them _1 charge_ on their holy tome.
talento.pixeldungeon.recuperar_inscricao:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Recall Inscription_, a spell that lets them repeat the effect of the last scroll they read within _10 turns_.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Recall Inscription_, a spell that lets them repeat the effect of the last scroll they read within _300 turns_.

It cannot be used with scrolls of upgrade. It costs 3 charges, or 6 with a scroll of transmutation.
talento.pixeldungeon.raio_solar.descrica:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Sunray_, a spell that deals _4-8 damage_ and blinds the target for _4 turns_, at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Sunray_, a spell that deals _6-12 damage_ and blinds the target for _6 turns_, at the cost of 1 charge.

Sunray can only blind each target once, but if the target is still blinded by Sunray then it is paralyzed.
talento.pixeldungeon.sentido_divino.desc:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Divine Sense_, an instant spell that grants them _8 tiles_ of mind vision for 50 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Divine Sense_, an instant spell that grants them _12 tiles_ of mind vision for 50 turns, at the cost of 2 charges.
talento.pixeldungeon.bencao.descricao:
_+1:_ The Cleric can cast _Bless_, a spell that grants _6 turns of bless and 10 shielding_ when cast on themselves or _10 turns of bless and 10 healing_ when cast on an ally, at the cost of 1 charge.

_+2:_ The Cleric can cast _Bless_, which grants _10 turns of bless and 15 shielding_ on themselves or _15 turns of bless and 15 healing_ on an ally, at the cost of 1 charge.

Excess healing is converted into shielding.
magia.pixeldungeon.recuperar_inscricao.d: Repeats the effect of the _last scroll_ the Cleric read (except upgrade). Each scroll can only be recalled once. With transmutation, it costs _double_.
magia.pixeldungeon.recuperar_inscricao.n: You haven't read a recent scroll to recall.
magia.pixeldungeon.raio_solar.descricao: Shoots a ray of sunlight where the Cleric is aiming, dealing damage and _blinding_ the target. If the target is still blinded by the ray, it is _paralyzed_.
magia.pixeldungeon.sentido_divino.descri: For 50 turns, the Cleric sees nearby enemies _through walls_. Takes no time.
magia.pixeldungeon.bencao.descricao: Blesses the _ally being aimed at_ (healing them) or, with no ally in sight, the Cleric (granting shielding). Blessed characters hit and dodge more.
item.pixeldungeon.pedra_de_arremesso.des: These stones are sanded down to make them able to be thrown with more power than a regular stone.
item.pixeldungeon.faca_de_arremesso.desc: These lightweight knives are balanced to arc through the air right into their target.
item.pixeldungeon.agulha_de_arremesso.de: These durable pointed shafts of metal are meant to be thrown into distant enemies.
item.pixeldungeon.lanca_de_pesca.descric: Tiny throwing spears that work well as an improvised weapon despite being designed for fishing.
item.pixeldungeon.bastao_de_arremesso.de: A fairly simple but durable thrown weapon, essentially a large rock fastened to a stick.
item.pixeldungeon.shuriken.descricao: These star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades can be quickly thrown while on the move.
item.pixeldungeon.lanca_de_arremesso.des: These lightweight spears have thin frames which are designed to be thrown, and not thrusted.
item.pixeldungeon.kunai.descricao: These small knives are very powerful in the hands of a skilled user.
item.pixeldungeon.boleadeiras.descricao: These unusual ranged weapons aren't very damaging, but do an excellent job of slowing their target.
item.pixeldungeon.javelin.descricao: These larger throwing spears are weighted to keep the spike at their tip foremost as they sail through the air.
item.pixeldungeon.tomahawk.descricao: These throwing axes have a serrated edge that tears as they stick to an enemy.
item.pixeldungeon.bumerangue_pesado.desc: This large boomerang is difficult to wield effectively, but will deal considerable damage.
item.pixeldungeon.tridente.descricao: Massive throwing spears with three deadly prongs on the end. They are powerful, but quite heavy.
item.pixeldungeon.martelo_de_arremesso.d: These hefty hammers are designed to be thrown at an enemy. Their smooth all-metal construction means they are quite durable.
item.pixeldungeon.cubo_de_forca.descrica: These oddly-shaped magical cubes are small enough to hold in your hand, but are incredibly heavy.
dica.pixeldungeon.arremesso.volta: Circles back to where it was thrown from after 5 turns
dica.pixeldungeon.arremesso.em_area: Hits everything near where it lands
dica.pixeldungeon.arremesso.nao_gruda: Doesn't stick to enemies: drops to the ground
dica.pixeldungeon.arremesso.distancia: More accurate at range, less accurate up close
mensagem.pixeldungeon.arremesso_quebrou: One of your thrown weapons has broken.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.arremesso_vai_queb: Your thrown weapon is about to break.
This fairly plain wand launches missiles of pure magical energy. While the wand itself lacks any special effects, it has more available charges.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_rajada_de_fogo: This wand is made from red-lacquered wood with golden leaf used liberally to make it look quite regal. It crackles and hisses at the tip, eager to unleash its powerful magic.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_geada.descrica: This wand seems to be made out of some kind of magical ice. It grows brighter towards its rounded tip. It feels very cold when held, but somehow your hand stays warm.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_relampago.desc: This wand is made out of solid metal, making it surprisingly heavy. Two prongs curve together at the tip, and electricity arcs between them.
This wand is made from a solid smooth chunk of obsidian, with a deep purple light running up its side, ending at the tip. It glows with destructive energy, waiting to shoot forward.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_luz_prismatica: This wand is made of a solid piece of translucent crystal, like a long chunk of smooth glass. Small bits of colorful light dance around the tip of the wand, eager to burst forth.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_corrosao.descr: This wand has an ashen body which opens to a brilliant orange gem.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_onda_de_choque: This wand is made of a sort of marbled stone, with gold trim and a round black gem at the tip. It feels very weighty in your hand.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_maturacao.desc: This wand is made from a thin shaft of expertly carved wood. Somehow it is still alive and vibrant, bright green like a young tree's core.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_transfusao.des: A fairly plainly shaped wand, it stands out due to its magenta hue and pitch black gem at the tip.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.colocar: Mage: sneaking, with the staff in the other hand, right click to imbue it into the staff
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.rajada_de_fogo: Cone of fire: the next zap uses %s charges and deals %s-%s damage. The more charges, the bigger and stronger.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.geada: Frost bolt: %s-%s damage, and the target is chilled (slower). Stronger in water.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.relampago: Lightning: %s-%s damage, arcing to nearby enemies (further in water).
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.desintegracao: A beam that pierces everything, even walls, for %3$s tiles: %1$s-%2$s damage, stronger for each enemy and wall it passes.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.luz_prismatica: Beam of light: %s-%s damage, and may blind the target.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.corrosao: A cloud of corrosive gas where the bolt stops: damage starts at %s and grows every turn.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.onda_de_choque: Blast: %s-%s damage around, and enemies are thrown away (hitting a wall hurts and paralyzes them).
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.maturacao: Cone of tall grass that roots enemies: the next zap uses %s charges.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.transfusao: On an ally, uses 5%% of your health to heal them by that + %s. On an enemy, it is charmed (won't attack) for 5 turns and you gain %s shielding.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.varinha_identifica: You are now familiar enough with your wand to identify it: %s.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.varinha_amaldicoad: The wand releases a cloud of toxic gas!
The magic takes you somewhere else!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.cajado.confirmar: The %s in your staff will be lost. Click again within 5 seconds to confirm.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.cajado.confirmar_p: The %s in your staff will be returned at +0. Click again within 5 seconds to confirm.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.cajado.colocou: You imbue your staff with the %s.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.caotica.descricao: This wand is cursed, making its magic chaotic and random.
item.pixeldungeon.anel.desconhecido.desc: This metal band is adorned with a large gem that glitters in the darkness. Who knows what effect it has when worn?
anel.pixeldungeon.precisao.descricao: This ring increases your focus, making it easier for your attacks to find their mark. A cursed ring will instead make it harder for your attacks to connect.
anel.pixeldungeon.arcano.descricao: This ring enhances magical enchantments on weapons and glyphs on armor, including curses! It first increases activation chance, and then increases the strength of the effect once activation chance is 100%. A cursed ring will instead weaken enchantments, glyphs, and curses.
anel.pixeldungeon.elementos.descricao: This ring provides resistance to most elemental and magical effects, decreasing damage and debuff duration. Naturally a cursed ring will instead worsen these effects.
anel.pixeldungeon.energia.descricao: Your magical equipment will recharge more quickly in the arcane field that radiates from this ring. A cursed ring will instead slow recharge.
anel.pixeldungeon.evasao.descricao: This ring quickens the wearer's reactions, making it harder to land blows on them. A cursed ring will instead make the user easier to strike.
anel.pixeldungeon.forca.descricao: This ring enhances the force of the wearer's melee blows. This extra power is fairly weak when wielding weapons, but an unarmed attack will be made much stronger. A cursed ring will instead weaken the wearer's blows.
anel.pixeldungeon.furia.descricao: This ring grants the wearer an inner fury, allowing them to attack more rapidly. A cursed ring will instead slow the wearer's speed of attack.
anel.pixeldungeon.pressa.descricao: This ring reduces the stress of movement on the wearer, allowing them to run at superhuman speeds. A cursed ring will instead weigh the wearer down.
anel.pixeldungeon.poder.descricao: This ring enhances the physical traits of the wearer, granting them greater physical strength and constitution. A cursed ring will weaken the wearer.
anel.pixeldungeon.tiro_certeiro.descrica: This ring enhances the wearer's precision and aim, which will make all projectile weapons more damaging and durable. A cursed ring will have the opposite effect.
anel.pixeldungeon.tenacidade.descricao: When worn, this ring will allow the wearer to resist normally mortal strikes. The more injured the user is, the more resistant they will be to damage. A cursed ring will instead make it easier for enemies to execute the wearer.
anel.pixeldungeon.fortuna.descricao: This ring acts like a magnet for treasure, increasing the likelihood that enemies and containers will be carrying valuable items. A cursed ring will instead reduce your chance of receiving loot.
dica.pixeldungeon.anel.elementos: Resistance to fire, frost, lightning, gas, poison and magic: %s
dica.pixeldungeon.anel.forca: Punches like a weapon of your strength tier, and %s damage with melee weapons
dica.pixeldungeon.anel.tiro_certeiro: Thrown weapons and bow: more damage, and %s uses
dica.pixeldungeon.anel.tenacidade: Less damage the more hurt you are (with almost no health left, resists %s)
dica.pixeldungeon.anel.por: Right click: put the ring on (up to 2)
dica.pixeldungeon.anel.tipico: (the effect of a +0 ring; its level is still unknown)
mensagem.pixeldungeon.anel_identificado: You are now familiar enough with your ring to identify it: %s.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.anel_amaldicoado: You can feel a malevolent magic lurking within this ring.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.anel_grudou: The ring tightens around your finger painfully!
maldicao.pixeldungeon.anel_amaldicoado.d: This ring is cursed: its effect is reversed, and it won't come off your finger.
glifo.pixeldungeon.ofuscamento.descricao: This glyph obscures the wearer, making them more difficult to detect: sleeping enemies take longer to notice them.
glifo.pixeldungeon.rapidez.descricao: This glyph enhances the speed of the wearer (1.2x, plus 0.04x per level) whenever they aren't within 3 tiles of an enemy.
glifo.pixeldungeon.viscosidade.descricao: This glyph is able to store damage dealt to the wearer, dealing it to them slowly (10% per turn) rather than all at once.
glifo.pixeldungeon.potencial.descricao: This glyph builds energy when struck, granting a charge to the wearer's wands and staff when it activates.
glifo.pixeldungeon.enxofre.descricao: This glyph shields the wearer and their belongings from fire, completely nullifying its damage and negative effects.
glifo.pixeldungeon.pedra.descricao: This glyph surrounds the armor with heavy magical stone that makes dodging impossible, but blocks damage in proportion with evasion.
glifo.pixeldungeon.emaranhamento.descric: This glyph grows earthen armor around the wearer to absorb damage (5, plus 2 per level), but this armor will break if the wearer moves.
glifo.pixeldungeon.repulsao.descricao: This glyph rebounds force against attackers, sending them flying 2 tiles back.
glifo.pixeldungeon.camuflagem.descricao: This glyph allows the wearer to blend into tall grass, granting them temporary invisibility when trampling it.
glifo.pixeldungeon.fluxo.descricao: This glyph manipulates the flow of water around the wearer, making them much faster (2x, plus 0.5x per level) when moving through it.
glifo.pixeldungeon.afeicao.descricao: This powerful glyph manipulates the mind of attackers, charming them temporarily.
glifo.pixeldungeon.antimagia.descricao: This powerful glyph allows armor to defend its wearer against magical attacks as well as physical ones. This magical defence is not affected by the armor's tier.
glifo.pixeldungeon.espinhos.descricao: This powerful glyph harms attackers, causing them to slowly bleed when they attack the wearer.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.multiplicidade.des: Armor cursed with multiplicity contains dangerous duplication magic. It will sometimes create a mirror image of the wearer, but is equally likely to duplicate the attacker!
maldicao.pixeldungeon.volumosa.descricao: Armor of bulk looks larger and more imposing, but doesn't actually have enhanced defense. Even worse, the added size makes moving into doorways very difficult.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.glifo_sumiu: The armor's glyph faded with the upgrade.
item.pixeldungeon.selo_quebrado.descrica: A wax seal, affixed to armor as a symbol of valor. It has a faded rune of protection engraved in the center, and is cracked in half across the middle. Right click to affix it to an armor; it carries along the upgrade it holds.
dica.pixeldungeon.selo_melhoria: The seal holds an upgrade (+1 on the next armor)
dica.pixeldungeon.selo_soltar: Sneak and right click with the armor in hand to detach the seal.
tela.pixeldungeon.escolher_item.selo: Choose an armor for the seal
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selo_sem_armadura: You have no armor to affix the seal to.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selo_armadura_desc: You must identify whether that armor is cursed or not first.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selo_armadura_amal: The seal won't apply to cursed armor.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selo_solto: You detach the seal from your armor.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selo_afixado: You affix the seal to your armor!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selo_passar: The broken seal stayed on the armor you took off. Move the seal to the armor you are wearing?
mensagem.pixeldungeon.selo_qual_glifo: The armor and the seal have different glyphs. Which one stays?
encantamento.pixeldungeon.flamejante.des: This enchantment causes flames to spit forth from a weapon, igniting enemies and dealing bonus damage to enemies that are already aflame. Activation chance: (level + 1) / (level + 3).
encantamento.pixeldungeon.congelante.des: Enemies struck with this enchantment are chilled, slowing their movement and attacks. Chance: (level + 1) / (level + 4); chills for 3 turns.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.inercial.descr: When an enemy is killed with a kinetic weapon, any excess force is stored in the weapon and will be applied to the next successful attack.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.chocante.descr: Electricity arcs from a shocking weapon, dealing extra damage to all nearby enemies. Chance: 1 in 3; the lightning deals half of the hit damage to anyone within 2 tiles.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.pestilente.des: Venomous weapons inflict a delayed but deadly poison, which becomes more severe each time it is applied. Chance: 1 in 3.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.bloqueante.des: Blocking weapons have a chance to briefly shield you after attacking with them. Chance: (level + 4) / (level + 40); grants 2 + level shielding.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.florescente.de: Blooming weapons contain magic which will cause vegetation to sprout on or around those struck by them. Chance: (level + 1) / (level + 3).
encantamento.pixeldungeon.eldritch.descr: Eldritch weapons strike fear into nearby enemies that witness their strikes, causing them to flee from the attacker. Chance: (level + 1) / (level + 4); terrifies for 5 turns.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.elastica.descr: Elastic weapons have a chance to send enemies flying back short distances. Chance: (level + 1) / (level + 5); knocks back 2 tiles.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.da_sorte.descr: Enemies which are killed by a lucky weapon have a chance to drop extra loot. Chance: (level + 4) / (level + 40) on each hit; the prize is a potion, a scroll, a seed or gold.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.projetante.des: With this enchantment melee weapons will gain extra reach. Ranged weapons will penetrate walls when aimed at nearby targets. In the mod, melee weapons gain 4 blocks of reach (1 Shattered tile).
encantamento.pixeldungeon.instavel.descr: This enchantment radiates chaotic energy, acting as a different enchantment with each hit.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.vorpal.descric: Vorpal weapons are especially deadly, they have a chance to strike so cleanly that they inflict bleed instead of damage to enemies that can bleed. Chance: 1 in 4.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.de_corrupcao.d: This powerful enchantment possesses the ability to turn enemies to your will. When an enemy is killed with this weapon, there is a chance they will become corrupted instead of dying. Chance: (level + 5) / (level + 20). The ally attacks the other enemies, follows you and loses 1% of its health per turn.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.de_cristal.des: This powerful enchantment deals extra magic damage and enhances a weapon's value. However, the enchanted weapon can shatter if the crystals aren't repaired, or given time to self-repair. Deals 33% extra magic damage.
encantamento.pixeldungeon.mortal.descric: This powerful enchantment possesses the power to instantly execute an enemy. The effect is more likely to occur the weaker the enemy is. Maximum chance: 50% + 5% per level.
This powerful enchantment leeches life force from enemies with each blow, funneling it back into the wearer. The effect is stronger the lower the wearer's health. Heals half of the hit damage.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.explosiva.descrica: Explosive weapons steadily build up power and explode, damaging anything nearby.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.amigavel.descricao: Friendly weapons are best suited for pacifists, occasionally triggering magic that makes it impossible to fight.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.pressurizante.desc: Pressurized weapons are capable of erupting with a forceful geyser of water which knocks everything away, including you.
maldicao.pixeldungeon.mirabolante.descri: Wondrous weapons contain the same chaotic magic found in cursed wands. There's no telling what will happen when this curse triggers!
maldicao.pixeldungeon.explosiva.morna: Your weapon is building energy and getting warm...
maldicao.pixeldungeon.explosiva.quente: Your weapon is hot! It's about to explode!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.encantamento_sumiu: The weapon's enchantment faded with the upgrade.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.cristal_quebrou: Your crystal weapon shatters into pieces!
efeito.pixeldungeon.mapeamento.segredos: The map also revealed hidden doors: %s. They are marked with columns of light.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sala_secreta_no_an: You're certain that there's a secret room somewhere on this floor.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_terra_viva.des: This wand is made from a curious rock, with bands of glowing yellow energy. The rocks seem to shift slightly as you grip the wand, as if they can feel your hand.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_corrupcao.desc: This wand radiates chaotic dark energy, if that weren't already obvious from the small decorative skull shaped onto its tip.
item.pixeldungeon.varinha_protecao.descr: This short metal wand has a bright purple gem floating above its tip.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.terra_viva: Bolts of rock: %1$s-%2$s damage. The rock reforms around you as armor, which blocks half of each hit. With %3$s armor, the next zap forms an earthen guardian, which fights by your side and turns back into rock when no enemies remain.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.corrupcao: No damage: weakens the enemy and, if it can't resist, corrupts it (it becomes your ally, and you get its XP and items). Corrupting power: %1$s. Debuffs last %2$s turns. Wounded enemies are much easier to corrupt.
dica.pixeldungeon.varinha.protecao: Places wards on the floor, which shoot enemies in sight on their own (%1$s-%2$s damage per shot). Zapping one of your wards upgrades it. Energy for %3$s wards at a time. Sneak and right-click one of your wards to dismiss it.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.ja_corrompido: That character cannot be influenced further.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sem_energia_pra_gu: Your wand can't sustain any more wards.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sem_lugar_pra_guar: You can't place a ward there.
item.pixeldungeon.lanca.descricao: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.
item.pixeldungeon.bastao.descricao: A staff of hardwood, its ends are shod with iron.
item.pixeldungeon.foice.descricao: A handheld farming tool that can double as a strong but unwieldy weapon.
item.pixeldungeon.cimitarra.descricao: A thick curved blade. Its shape allows for faster, yet less powerful attacks.
item.pixeldungeon.escudo_redondo.descric: This large shield effectively blocks attacks and makes a decent weapon in a pinch.
item.pixeldungeon.chicote.descricao: While the barbed length of rope at the end of this weapon deals poor damage, its reach cannot be matched.
item.pixeldungeon.espada_longa.descricao: This sword's long razor-sharp steel blade shines reassuringly, though its size does make it quite heavy.
item.pixeldungeon.machado_de_batalha.des: The enormous steel head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each wide stroke.
item.pixeldungeon.mangual.descricao: A spiked ball attached to a handle by a length of chain. Very unwieldy, but devastating if it lands a solid hit.
item.pixeldungeon.lamina_runica.descrica: A mysterious weapon from a distant land, with a bright blue blade.
item.pixeldungeon.besta.descricao: A fairly intricate weapon which shoots bolts at exceptional speeds. While it isn't designed for it, this crossbow's heft and sturdy construction make it a decent melee weapon as well.
item.pixeldungeon.gladio.descricao: A massive polearm consisting of a sword blade on the end of a pole.
item.pixeldungeon.machado_grande.descric: Meant to be wielded over the shoulder, this titanic axe is as powerful as it is heavy.
item.pixeldungeon.escudo_grande.descrica: More like a mobile wall than a shield, this gigantic mass of metal aids defense, but doesn't leave much room for attacking.
item.pixeldungeon.manopla_de_pedra.descr: This massive gauntlet is made of crimson fabric with heavy magical stone layered on top. The fabric tightens around you, making the thick stone plates almost like a second skin. Swinging such a heavy weapon requires strength, but adds tremendous force to your blows.
item.pixeldungeon.foice_de_guerra.descri: This large and unwieldy tool has been reinforced to make it better at cutting foes than crops.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.espetar.descrica: The Duelist spikes an enemy that is within reach but not adjacent, dealing _+%s damage_ with guaranteed accuracy, and knocks the enemy back.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.postura_defensiv: The Duelist takes a defensive stance, which is instant and _triples her evasion_ for _%s turns_.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.ceifar.descricao: An attack with guaranteed accuracy that deals _%s damage_, applied as bleeding.
The Duelist starts a sword dance, which is instant and grants _+60%% attack speed_ and _+50%% accuracy_ for _%s turns_.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.defender.descric: The Duelist guards with her shield, negating _all attacks_ against her for _%s turns_. After blocking an attack, attacking or using magic ends the guard.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.chicotear.descri: The Duelist lashes _every enemy_ within reach, with guaranteed accuracy.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.girar.descricao: The Duelist spins her flail: her next regular attack is guaranteed to hit and deals _+%s damage_ per spin, up to 3 spins. Only the first spin costs a charge; each spin lasts 3 turns.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.corte_runico.des: An attack with guaranteed accuracy and _+%s%% enchantment power_.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.tiro_carregado.d: The Duelist charges her crossbow: her next regular attack is guaranteed to hit and _knocks the enemy back_ 4 tiles.
habilidade.pixeldungeon.retribuicao.desc: Only below half health: an attack with guaranteed accuracy and _+%s damage_.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_espetar: That target is too close to spike.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_giro_ma: You can't spin the flail any more.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.habilidade_vida_al: You can only use retribution below half health.
item.pixeldungeon.calice_de_sangue.descr: This shining silver chalice is oddly adorned with sharp gems at the rim. Each time you prick yourself on it, it drains more of your life energy, but further enhances your natural health regeneration in exchange.
dica.pixeldungeon.calice_de_sangue.uso: Equipped (in hand or offhand): heal faster. Right click (twice): prick yourself and level it up.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.calice_de_sangue.c: Pricking yourself now will deal %s-%s damage (armor blocks some of it). Click again to confirm.
Careful: pricking yourself now deals %s-%s damage and may kill you! Click again to confirm.
The chalice is filled to the brim with your life essence.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.calice_de_sangue.s: You prick yourself, and your life essence drains into the chalice.
item.pixeldungeon.chifre_da_fartura.desc: This horn can't be blown into, but instead seems to fill up with food as you adventure and gain experience. Perhaps there is a way to increase the horn's power by giving it food energy.
dica.pixeldungeon.chifre_da_fartura.uso: Right click: eat a snack (1 charge). Sneaking: feed the horn some food (every ration stored levels it up).
Your horn has no food in it to eat!
Your horn has consumed all the food it can!
You have no food to give the horn.
The horn consumes your food offering.
The horn consumes your food offering and grows in strength!
item.pixeldungeon.ampulheta_do_tempo.des: This large ornate hourglass looks fairly unassuming, but you feel a great power in its finely carved frame. As you rotate the hourglass and watch the sand pour you can feel its magic tugging at you. The hourglass seems to have lost some sand. If only you could find some...
dica.pixeldungeon.ampulheta_do_tempo.uso: Right click: stasis (up to 2 charges, 5 turns each; you are frozen, invisible and invulnerable). Sneaking: freeze time around you (1 charge every 2 turns; attacking or using it again ends it).
mensagem.pixeldungeon.ampulheta_do_tempo: Your hourglass hasn't recharged enough to be usable yet.
item.pixeldungeon.livro_instavel.descric: This Tome is in surprising good condition given its age. It fizzles and crackles as you move the pages, surging with unstable energy. If you read from this book, there's no telling what spell you might cast. The book is incomplete: its index points to blank pages.
dica.pixeldungeon.livro_instavel.uso: Right click: read a random spell (1 charge). Sneaking: give the book one of the scrolls it asks for (identified) and level it up.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.livro_instavel.ceg: You cannot read from the book while blinded.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.livro_instavel.sem: Your spellbook is out of energy for now.
You have no identified scroll the book is asking for.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.livro_instavel.sub: You infuse the scroll's energy into the book.
item.pixeldungeon.correntes_etereas.desc: These large yet lightweight chains glow with spiritual energy. They can be used to pull you towards terrain, or pull enemies toward you. The chains rest around your side, slowly siphoning the spiritual energy of those you defeat. Each charge is a link in the chain, which will extend out exactly one tile.
dica.pixeldungeon.correntes_etereas.uso: Right click while aiming: on an enemy, pull it to you; on a wall, pull yourself to it (1 charge per tile).
Your chains do not have enough charge.
Your chains cannot pull you while you are rooted.
Your chains can only pull you through walls, not into them.
There is nothing to grab there.
item.pixeldungeon.talisma_da_videncia.de: A smooth stone with strange engravings on it. You feel like it's watching everything around you, keeping an eye out for anything unusual. The talisman slowly builds charge as time passes, and when you discover hidden doors.
dica.pixeldungeon.talisma_da_videncia.us: Right click while aiming: scry in a cone up to where you aim (reveals hidden doors and shows enemies through walls).
mensagem.pixeldungeon.talisma_da_videnci: Your talisman requires at least 5% charge to scry.
The talisman only works inside the dungeon.
item.pixeldungeon.bracadeira_do_ladrao.d: This purple velvet armband bears the mark of a master thief. This doesn't belong to you, but it probably didn't belong to its last user either. You feel power building in it as you gain experience. Robbing briefly disorients the enemy, and is more effective against enemies that haven't noticed you. Robbing the same enemy multiple times won't give more chances at loot.
dica.pixeldungeon.bracadeira_do_ladrao.u: Right click while aiming at an adjacent enemy: rob it (1 charge).
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bracadeira_do_ladr: Your armband does not have enough charge.
You must target an enemy that is adjacent to you.
That enemy has nothing to steal.
You didn't manage to steal anything.
What initially seem like sandals made of twine are actually two plants! They charge as you trample tall grass. Once fed a seed, they can briefly root into the ground and produce that plant's effect anywhere in a 3 tile radius.
Right click while aiming (up to 3 tiles): the last seed's effect. Sneaking: feed a seed to the footwear.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sandalias_da_natur: You have no seed the footwear will accept.
The footwear absorbs the seed, they seem healthier.
You must feed a seed to your footwear first.
Your footwear don't have enough energy for that.
That location is out of range.
item.pixeldungeon.chave_de_cranio.descri: An important-looking key with a skull for a head. Its teeth seem to be different every time you look at it. It can be inserted into almost every lock in the dungeon to open or close it, including doors that were never locked before. It can even "lock" the air in front of you, creating a solid 3-tile-wide wall that lasts 10 turns.
dica.pixeldungeon.chave_de_cranio.uso: Right click a door: unlock (1 charge) or lock (2 charges). Right click elsewhere: walls in front of you (2 charges).
mensagem.pixeldungeon.chave_de_cranio.se: Opening a regular lock requires 1 charge.
Creating a temporary wall requires 2 charges.
You can't lock a character inside of a door!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.chave_de_cranio.lu: There's nothing to lock or unlock there.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.chave_de_cranio.tr: This door was locked by your skeleton key.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.chave_de_cranio.fo: The lock is weaker without your skeleton key. You're able to force it open.
fantasma.pixeldungeon.rato_1:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by a foul beast... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the fetid rat, that has taken my life...

It stalks this floor... Spreading filth everywhere... Beware its cloud of stink and corrosive bite, the acid dissolves in water...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.rato_2:
Please... Help me... Slay the abomination...

Fight it near water... Avoid the stench...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.gnoll_1:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by a devious foe... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the gnoll trickster, that has taken my life...

It is not like the other gnolls... It hides and uses thrown weapons... Beware its poisonous and incendiary darts, don't attack from a distance...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.gnoll_2:
Please... Help me... Slay the trickster...

Don't let it hit you... Get near to it...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.caranguejo_1:
Hello %s... Once I was like you - strong and confident... But I was slain by an ancient creature... I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the great crab, that has taken my life...

It is unnaturally old... With a massive single claw and a thick shell... Beware its claw, you must surprise the crab or it will block with it...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.caranguejo_2:
Please... Help me... Slay the Crustacean...

It will always block... When it sees you coming...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.rato_obrigado: Thank you, that horrid rat is slain and I can finally rest... I wonder what twisted magic created such a foul creature...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.gnoll_obrigado: Thank you, that scheming gnoll is slain and I can finally rest... I wonder what twisted magic made it so smart...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.caranguejo_obrigad: Thank you, that giant crab is slain and I can finally rest... I wonder what twisted magic allowed it to live so long...
fantasma.pixeldungeon.recompensa:
Please take one of these items, they are useless to me now... Maybe they will help you in your journey...

Also... There is an item lost in this dungeon that is very dear to me... If you ever... find my... rose......
The crab blocks with its massive claw.
item.pixeldungeon.rosa_seca.descricao: A dried aged rose that is somehow still holding together despite its age. Is this the rose that the ghost mentioned before disappearing? It seems to hold some spiritual power, perhaps it can be used to channel the energy of that lost warrior. It seems to be missing some petals; perhaps reattaching them will strengthen the rose.
dica.pixeldungeon.rosa_seca.uso: Only works after the ghost's quest. Right click: summon the ghost (full charge); with it around, give orders while aiming (enemy: attack; ground: hold the spot; nothing: follow). Sneaking: give the ghost a weapon or armor.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.rosa_seca.sem_miss: It seems to have some spiritual power, but you have no idea how to use it right now.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.rosa_seca.sem_carg: Your rose isn't fully charged yet.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.rosa_seca.nada_pra: The ghost only uses weapons and armor you're sure aren't cursed, requiring up to %s strength.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.rosa_seca.subiu: You add the petal to the rose.
tela.pixeldungeon.escolher_item.rosa_sec: A weapon or armor for the ghost (the rose takes back what it has)
item.pixeldungeon.petala_seca.descricao: A frail dried up petal, which has somehow survived this far into the dungeon. In the pack of whoever has the dried rose, it goes back to the rose.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.petala_seca.sem_es: There is no room left for this petal, so you discard it.
fantasma_aliado.pixeldungeon.apresentar: My spirit is bound to this rose, it was very precious to me, a gift from my love whom I left on the surface. I cannot return to him, but thanks to you I have a second chance to complete my journey. When I am able I will respond to your call and fight with you. As long as you have the rose I can hear your voice, so you can use it to direct me from afar. Hopefully you may succeed where I failed...
fantasma_aliado.pixeldungeon.esgoto_1: These sewers used to be safe, people even lived here in the winter.
fantasma_aliado.pixeldungeon.esgoto_2: I wonder what happened to the guard patrols, did they give up?
fantasma_aliado.pixeldungeon.esgoto_3: I had family on the surface, I hope they're safe.
fantasma_aliado.pixeldungeon.esgoto_4: The guards couldn't defeat these monsters, but maybe we can.
fantasma_aliado.pixeldungeon.esgoto_5: If even the sewers are this dangerous, I wonder what's below...
fantasma_aliado.pixeldungeon.esgoto_6: What could have caused these rats and crabs to grow so large?
